summary: The pattern becomes more useful when memory maintenance is treated as ordinary repository maintenance rather than a separate knowledge-management programme.

items.text: Validate index targets, duplicate identifiers, broken links and supersession cycles in continuous integration.
Display recalled file paths and revisions alongside agent output so an operator can inspect the effective context.
Assign review intervals by consequence: command syntax and operational policy expire faster than historical rationale.
Connect durable memory to the existing pattern for searchable decisions rather than creating a parallel decision archive.
Classify an assertion as working, episodic, semantic or procedural memory before applying durable-memory maintenance rules.
Load memory through small, explicit context entry points instead of injecting the whole folder into every run.
